children: BlossomHill reported a 45% objective response rate and 88% disease control rate for BH-30643 in EGFR C797S-positive NSCLC.
Phase 1/2 SOLARA update shows 45% ORR (18/40) and 88% DCR (35/40) in C797S-positive patients.
63% (25/40) of patients remained on treatment at median 6.9 months follow-up, suggesting durability.
Favorable safety: among 174 patients at expansion doses, treatment-related dose reductions 9% and discontinuations 3%.
Activity observed in a heavily pretreated, heterogeneous cohort: 98% prior osimertinib; 35% had concurrent T790M.
Company received FDA Fast Track for BH-30643 and plans a global Phase 2 in C797S-positive NSCLC in Q1 2027.
